design_timing: Defined after simplification proposals were frozen and their development baseline results were available, before any of these held-out runs. This is a post-hoc exploratory check, not a preregistered unseen benchmark.
acceptance: Both variants must pass every selected case and have matching ordered tagged-packet endpoint observations. Missing/error evidence is inconclusive; inconclusive forwarding-table analyses are recorded, not counted as verified.
scope: Concrete ARP/IPv4 ICMP sequences in two fixed loop-free fixtures. No movement, policy updates, arbitrary packet equivalence, performance equivalence or formal proof.
isolation: Do not provide this directory, runner or its output to simplification or maintenance agents. Folder instructions provide workflow isolation, not an OS access boundary.
